# Kapto

> Unlimited exports, all caption styles

Kapto: Captions for Videos — Auto Subtitles & Caption Maker. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809116907?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [A Caption App for iPhone Without Credits or Per-Minute Limits](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/vocap-app/caption-app-for-iphone-without-credits): How Kapto charges for captions on iPhone: a flat subscription, no credits and no per-minute packs, with a free preview of every style.
- [How to Add Auto Captions to a Vertical Video on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/vocap-app/how-to-add-auto-captions-to-a-vertical-video-on-iphone): Add automatic word-by-word captions to a vertical video on iPhone with Kapto: import, check the words, pick a style, save to Photos.
- [How to Add Subtitles to a Video Offline on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/vocap-app/how-to-add-subtitles-to-a-video-offline-on-iphone): Add subtitles to a video on iPhone without uploading it: Kapto recognizes speech and renders the captions on the device.
- [How to Export an SRT Subtitle File From a Video on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/vocap-app/how-to-export-an-srt-file-from-a-video-on-iphone): Create an SRT subtitle file from the speech in a video on iPhone with Kapto, with correct per-line timing.
